items.item_text: Associates Degree in Nursing from an accredited school of nursing.
BS degree in nursing from an accredited school of nursing

1 year recent PACU experience in an acute care setting and 2 years recent critical care or emergency department experience. NOTE: Candidates not meeting the PACU experience requirement may be considered if operational conditions exist to support the training of a candidate and no candidates meeting the experience requirements apply.
Formulates a goal directed plan of care that is prioritized and based on nursing diagnosis and desired outcomes

Implements care in a knowledgeable, skillful, consistent and continuous manner. Assesses patients' physical, psychosocial, spiritual and learning needs at the preop interview and develops a plan for care
Performs documentation on unit and patient records that is timely, accurate and concise
Participates in staff orientation and development activities for unit and nursing division personnel as requested
Assumes responsibility for professional growth by taking advantage of the available opportunities
Participates in unit quality management and PI improvement activities
